card.name: Benefit-versus-risk phrasing and onset lists
card.fires_on: The word "clearly" after "if the benefit(s)" in pregnancy and nursing warnings, and the comma after "abrupt in onset" in antidepressant suicidality warnings.

modes.label: Benefit clearly justifies
modes.description: The word "clearly" right after "only if the benefit(s)" in pregnancy or nursing statements.
modes.example: only if the benefit<< clearly>> justifies a potential risk to the fetus

modes.label: Comma after abrupt in onset
modes.description: The comma closing the list "severe, abrupt in onset" in worsening depression and suicidality warnings.
modes.example: especially if these symptoms are severe, abrupt in onset<<,>> or were not part of the patient's
